tools.name: almond_project_info
tools.title: Almond Project Info
tools.description:
Read the bound model, DB and artifact_dir before the first Rhino action.

Use artifact_dir as the explicit absolute base for task-local reports,
screenshots and temporary code, including C# executed inside Rhino and
shell/image reads. mcp_temp/effective_temp belong to Python; Rhino's original
TEMP (rhino_temp_at_attach) may differ and is not the project output path.
This is binding metadata, not a live active-document check. For a terminal
connection, use /exit, switch the saved document, then almond to reconnect.

tools.name: apply_drawing_style
tools.title: Apply Drawing Style
tools.description:
Creates or updates the Rhino layer hierarchy, plot weights, colours, and
linetypes defined by an audited drawing recipe.

tools.name: assign_material
tools.title: Assign Material
tools.description:
Assigns a curated PBR material and its canonical M:: layer to explicit Rhino objects.
The compiled helper creates only the chosen material/layer on demand and reuses
existing entries. Returns applied GUIDs without adding automatic dimensions.

For structural members, also declare what the object IS in construction
terms: structural_role (e.g. "joist", "girder", "stud", "truss_chord")
and construction_system (a system_id from get_construction_guidance).
An explicit structural_role retains its legacy user-text key. A system is
stored as the typed construction_reference described below. If the chosen material_id is
not a typical finish for the declared system, the response carries a
warning (it still applies).

floor is a user-supplied level label. construction_detail is a readable label;
construction_reference optionally identifies a known source as
{"kind": "construction_system", "id": "<system_id>"}. These source records
are preliminary system guidance, not verified construction details. The old
construction_system argument is accepted and produces the same typed reference.
A source name supplies the detail label when no explicit label is given.

Two effects, independently switchable:
- apply_render_material: creates/reuses a physically-based Rhino
  material (ALMOND::<material_id>) and assigns it per object, so GLB
  export (publish_to_chestnut) and Datasmith carry real PBR channels. The
  object's layer follows the material's layer_path. If false, neither the
  native material nor the layer is changed or created.
- attach_metadata: writes only material_id when a native material is
  applied, plus supplied floor/detail/reference metadata. PBR channels
  remain on the native material. A metadata-only call preserves the
  current material identity and writes only the supplied metadata.

Unspecified metadata and asset provenance are preserved. Requires a Bridge
with modeling_materials=1; older Bridges are rejected before any mutation.
Works on breps, meshes, and block instances (an instance's material
applies to definition geometry set to 'by parent'; the metadata is
always attached to the instance itself). Call list_materials first to
discover material_ids.

tools.name: audit_asset_drawing
tools.title: Audit Asset Drawing
tools.description:
Check exported files and whether source geometry changed. Custom packages
need the current source_glb to check staleness; library assets resolve automatically.

tools.name: capture_conditioning_pass
tools.title: Capture Conditioning Pass
tools.description:
Capture RGB + edge (line drawing) + depth frames along a camera path from the LIVE Rhino
document, as conditioning for geometry-guided video generation (Wan VACE / ControlNet).
Depth and edges are read from the model itself, not estimated, and every frame's camera is
recorded so the generated video can be re-projected against the source geometry.

The shot JSON describes a camera path in model units, usually mm, using one of these forms.
  {"type":"orbit","center":[x,y,z],"radius":r,"height":z,"frames":81,
   "start_deg":0,"end_deg":90,"lens":35,"target_height":z}
  {"type":"track","cam0":[x,y,z],"cam1":[..],"target0":[..],"target1":[..],"frames":81,"lens":35}
  {"type":"keyframes","keyframes":[{"camera":[..],"target":[..],"lens":35}, ...],"frames":81}
Use 4n+1 frames for Wan models (17, 33, 49, 65, 81). 81 frames = 5 s at 16 fps.

Writes to out_dir: rgb/ edge/ depth/ (f0000.png ...), rgb.mp4 / edge.mp4 / depth.mp4
(when ffmpeg is available), camera.json (per-frame camera receipt, schema building0.camera/0.1),
zrange.csv (per-frame depth range), doc.json, summary.json. Depth is grayscale with near = bright
(Rhino's native convention, what Wan/ControlNet depth expects); set invert_depth for near = dark.
Camera restoration is best effort after the pass. Returns the summary JSON.

tools.name: check_egress
tools.title: Check Egress
tools.description:
Checks a floor plate's means of egress against the construction library's
egress rules (BCI A.10-A.13 framework + IBC-typical numeric factors -
always verify against the governing code; the response repeats this).

Call AFTER laying out cores/exits and BEFORE detailing: it verifies exit
count, exit separation, egress width, travel distances and dead ends in
one pass, and names the failing requirement so the layout can be fixed
(add an exit, move a core, widen a stair) instead of guessed at.

plate_bounds_mm.description:
Floor plate [min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y] in mm
(sets gross area and the diagonal used for exit separation).

exits.description:
One entry per exit (stair door or exterior exit door):
{"name": str, "x_mm": float, "y_mm": float, "width_mm": float}.
Positions are the door centers; width is the clear egress width.

occupancy.description:
Occupant-load key: business, mercantile, assembly_
unconcentrated, classroom, residential, storage.

stories.description:
Stories served. Above 1, at least two exits are required
and exit width demand uses the stair factor (7.6 mm/occupant)
instead of the door factor (5.1).

sprinklered.description:
Sprinklered throughout (affects separation fraction,
travel-distance and dead-end limits).

net_area_m2.description: Override the occupied area; 0 uses the gross plate area.

travel_distances_m.description:
Measured worst-case travel distances (e.g. from
drawn egress paths); empty skips the travel check.

dead_end_m.description: Longest dead-end corridor in metres; 0 skips the check.

tools.name: create_design_scene
tools.title: Create Design Scene
tools.description:
Creates a persistent scene handle for a house or interior generation.
Scene metadata remains local and is retrieved by ID instead of being
repeated in the model context.

tools.name: create_generation_phase
tools.title: Create Generation Phase
tools.description: Create an organizational Phase for Plans; this does not edit Rhino geometry.

tools.name: create_generation_plan
tools.title: Create Generation Plan
tools.description:
Create a dependency-ordered Plan in an optional organizational Phase.
scope is house, interior, structure, drawing, or component; component uses
inspect_context, design, model, validate. scene_ids are context; component_ids
explicitly bind targets without requiring membership in those Scenes.
Legacy scene_id must match the first scene_ids entry when both are supplied.
Plans record state and evidence, do not execute steps, and do not authorize edits.

tools.name: execute_rhino_script
tools.title: Execute Rhino Script

script.description: C# source code containing a class with public static Run(RhinoDoc doc).

tools.name: export_asset_contract
tools.title: Export Asset Contract
tools.description:
Exports Rhino objects as a portable Almond asset: a GLB plus an asset
contract (.almond.json) carrying what the file cannot.

The contract records real dimensions in mm, the anchor and support plane,
clearances, and the Almond material_id of every object - so another
application (Blender, Unreal, another Rhino) can restore full meaning
even though glTF drops per-object metadata. Pair with
import_asset_contract on the receiving side.

guids.description: Rhino object GUIDs to export (from execute_rhino_script).

tools.name: export_structural_report
tools.title: Export Structural Report
tools.description:
Renders the persisted validate_structure history to a Markdown report.

Every successful validate_structure call is recorded in the local state
database (inputs, analysis method, confidence, numbers, warnings). This
tool writes them to a .md file, newest first, with an explanation of the
analysis pathways and pass criteria.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to include (default 50, max 500).

tools.name: focus_components
tools.title: Focus Components
tools.description:
Select, isolate and zoom to current recursive members of 1-32 Components.

Uses Rhino's existing Isolate/Unisolate history; other hidden/locked context
and any existing document state are subject to the native helper's guards.
The operation changes the live selection/visibility/view. An uncertain native
result must be inspected; it is never automatically retried.

tools.name: generate_asset_drawing_views
tools.title: Generate Asset Drawing Views
tools.description:
Generate plan/front/right mesh silhouettes with source metadata, full-size DXF,
scaled SVG and A3 SVG sheets where they fit. Writes a NEW local drawing-runs folder.
Choose a library asset_id OR an absolute custom source_glb path. Custom files
REQUIRE input_units mm or m; up_axis y or z. Scales default to [50,100].
Supports static, uncompressed triangle GLBs only (max 100 MB/250k triangles).
No hidden lines, inferred construction or product-front recognition.
Optional item-level source_references require source_id/title/url/publisher/
locator/accessed_on/relationship/used_for/terms_url. They describe references
attached to this drawing, never retroactive generation inputs.

tools.name: get_asset_drawing
tools.title: Get Asset Drawing
tools.description: Retrieve a registered 3DM's linked drawings and dimensions, or a legacy pilot package.

tools.name: get_blender_helper_script
tools.title: Get Blender Helper Script
tools.description:
Returns Python to run inside Blender (via blender-mcp's execute_code) so
Blender participates in the Almond workflow without a dedicated bridge.

tools.name: get_component_intersections
tools.title: Get Component Intersections
tools.description:
Inspect actual solid overlaps among the current recursive members of 1-32 Components.

The native helper resolves current group members inside the same callback,
tests bounded candidate pairs, and reports unsupported/truncated/unknown work.
A successful call is not proof of no collision unless complete is true.
This helper does not modify Rhino objects or the local Scene ledger.

tools.name: get_construction_guidance
tools.title: Get Construction Guidance
tools.description:
Curated construction-system guidance for generating structures that are
built the way real buildings are built - not arbitrary members in space.
Parameters are distilled from Ching's Building Construction Illustrated
(4th ed.): per-system span ranges, depth rules of thumb (depth = span/N),
member spacing, element roles, and assembly notes.

Call this BEFORE generating structural geometry: pick a system, size and
space members from its rules, then generate and run validate_structure
(which cross-checks the result against this same library). Each system
names its structural_material (validate_structure vocabulary) and
render_material_ids (assign_material vocabulary), so the declared
construction material flows through analysis AND appears on the Rhino
objects.

span_m.description:
If > 0, each returned system reports fits_span and
suggested member depths from its span-ratio rules.

include_reference_data.description:
Also return occupancy live loads (kPa) and
material densities (kg/m3) for choosing load_kn inputs.

tools.name: get_design_component
tools.title: Get Design Component
tools.description:
Read cached direct/nested Component members or inspect live Rhino group membership.

live=True reads the actual group, including unowned group-added TextDots as
pending_objects requiring explicit sync; it never changes Rhino or the ledger.

tools.name: get_design_scene
tools.title: Get Design Scene
tools.description: Returns a token-efficient scene summary by stable handle.

tools.name: get_diagram_asset
tools.title: Get Diagram Asset
tools.description: Returns one diagram asset's metadata.

tools.name: get_drawing_asset
tools.title: Get Drawing Asset
tools.description: Returns one drawing asset's provenance, scale guidance, and availability.

tools.name: get_drawing_recipe
tools.title: Get Drawing Recipe
tools.description: Returns one complete audited drawing recipe.

tools.name: get_drawing_sheet
tools.title: Get Drawing Sheet
tools.description: Read a cached sheet title, scale, paper, modelspace bounds, Layout and context refs.

tools.name: get_generation_phase
tools.title: Get Generation Phase
tools.description: Read a Phase's name, description and Plan count.

tools.name: get_generation_plan
tools.title: Get Generation Plan
tools.description:
Read the current Plan or an immutable saved revision, including legacy baseline 0.

Snapshots contain Plan metadata, step state and handles; they are not Rhino
geometry backups. A missing requested revision never falls back to current state.

tools.name: get_logic_by_id
tools.title: Get Logic By Id
tools.description:
Retrieves parsed physics context for a specific Kangaroo2 or Karamba3D archetype.
Returns detected components, descriptions, and metadata extracted from the
Grasshopper binary file.

logic_id.description:
The filename (without extension) of the Grasshopper file.
      Use list_library() first to see available IDs.
      Examples: catenary, bending, 01_simplebeam

tools.name: get_modeling_policy
tools.title: Get Modeling Policy
tools.description:
Return JSON-defined object/group metadata keys and material-layer naming rules.

Names are free. New modeling normally needs only component_id (registration),
optional floor and construction_detail, plus material identity and a typed source
reference when used. Internal compatibility keys are not a checklist to fill.

tools.name: get_retrieval_status
tools.title: Get Retrieval Status
tools.description: Returns compact diagnostics for the local structured retrieval system.

tools.name: get_rhino_context
tools.title: Get Rhino Context
tools.description:
Read the LIVE bound Rhino document, selection and current viewport on the UI thread.

Includes document identity/path, units/tolerances, object/layer counts, a bounded
selection summary and camera/display metadata. This query does not create layers,
geometry, dimensions or an Undo record. Unavailable values are null with warnings.
Counts and the current view are context, not a geometric or visibility validation.
Use this snapshot before focused object inspection or editing an existing model.

selection_limit.description: Maximum selected object summaries, from 0 to 200; total/truncated are still reported.

tools.name: get_rhino_probe
tools.title: Get Rhino Probe
tools.description:
Read fixed geometry observations on the bound Rhino UI thread without modifying the document.

Does not execute supplied C#, create layers/Undo records, edit geometry, select objects,
change views or write files. Requires the Bridge fixed_probes capability. Requests and
responses are limited to 256 KiB of UTF-8 JSON. Unknown/omitted/truncated observations
do not mean zero, clearance, structural approval or design correctness.

probe.description: One of outline, resolve-block, sections, vertical-probe, joint-pairs.

expected_model_path.description: Absolute normalized saved .3dm path from project_info; must match the active document.

tools.name: get_rhino_viewport_image
tools.title: Get Rhino Viewport Image
tools.description:
Return the LIVE current Rhino viewport as a JPEG image with document/view metadata.

Captures the current view without changing its camera, projection, display mode,
clipping, selection or Undo history. The image preserves the viewport aspect ratio
within the requested bounds; it does not zoom to fit or prove geometric correctness.
A missing view, failed capture or oversized image is an explicit error, never a stale
file. Use capture_conditioning_pass for deliberate camera paths and multiple passes.

max_width.description: Maximum image width in pixels, from 64 to 2048.

max_height.description: Maximum image height in pixels, from 64 to 2048.

tools.name: get_scene_objects
tools.title: Get Scene Objects
tools.description: Read cached direct Scene objects and all descendant Component members as one set.

tools.name: get_typology_narrative
tools.title: Get Typology Narrative
tools.description:
Architectural typology narratives for project storytelling - precedents,
eras, and urban roles distilled from Ching, Jarzombek & Prakash's
A Global History of Architecture, with page references (gha_ref).

NARRATION ONLY: use these entries to caption, contextualize and narrate
a design (which tradition a courtyard block belongs to, what a truss
hall's civic ancestors are). They must NEVER drive geometry, member
sizing, or structural decisions - that is get_construction_guidance's
job. A natural pairing: after building with a construction system, call
this with construction_system=<that system_id> to fetch the lineage for
the project description.

construction_system.description:
Filter to entries related to a construction
library system_id (e.g. "steel-column-frame").

tools.name: import_asset_contract
tools.title: Import Asset Contract
tools.description:
Imports an Almond asset contract (from Blender, Unreal, or another Rhino)
into the open Rhino document, restoring everything the file format drops.

Runs the full receive sequence: import the GLB, collapse the duplicate
materials glTF creates, restore canonical PBR values from the Almond
material library (glTF round trips shift base colours), re-attach the
almond:* metadata keyed off the surviving material name, place the asset
at the requested point using the contract's anchor, and verify the
measured size against the contract's recorded dimensions.

tools.name: import_drawing_hatch_patterns
tools.title: Import Drawing Hatch Patterns
tools.description:
Imports the AutoCAD-style .pat hatch definitions of an indexed drawing
asset into the active Rhino document's hatch pattern table.

The tool accepts only .pat files resolved from the controlled
asset/drawing/DrawingAssetfiles manifest, mirroring the placement tools' security
boundary.

tools.name: list_capsules
tools.title: List Capsules
tools.description:
Lists Grasshopper capsules: GH definitions with a typed, audited input/output
contract that can be executed via run_gh_definition.

Call this FIRST to discover what capsules exist before calling run_gh_definition.
Each entry is a compact card with capsule_id, capability, structure_type,
audited flag, and the reserved ALMOND_IN_* / ALMOND_OUT_* port names. Only
capsules with audited=true can actually run; audited=false capsules are
retrieval context only (read them via get_logic_by_id instead).

audited_only.description: When true, list only capsules that run_gh_definition will accept.

tools.name: list_design_codes
tools.title: List Design Codes
tools.description:
Lists the design code profiles validate_structure / visualize_structure accept as design_code.

A profile holds the numbers a design code or National Annex sets (load factors gamma_G,
gamma_Q, psi_0, xi; the ULS expression; material factors gamma_M0, gamma_M1; the deflection
limit; suggested imposed floor loads), each with its source clause and a verified flag.
"eurocode" (EN recommended values) is built in and the default; "off" is unfactored mechanics.
Practices add National Annex profiles as JSON files in user_dir (see docs/structure/design-codes.md).
Unverified values are allowed but flagged in every result that uses them.

Returns JSON: default, profiles [{id, name, basis, origin, verified, unverified,
uls_expression, uls_default, deflection_limit_ratio, imposed_floor_kn_m2}], problems
(files that failed validation), user_dir.

tools.name: list_design_components
tools.title: List Design Components
tools.description: List compact cached Components, optionally restricted to one saved model path.

tools.name: list_diagram_assets
tools.title: List Diagram Assets
tools.description: Lists available vector and CAD diagram assets (people, trees, symbols).

tools.name: list_drawing_assets
tools.title: List Drawing Assets
tools.description:
Lists representation-only entourage and graphic proxy assets.

Drawing assets are representation elements and do
not participate in room collision checks unless explicitly registered.

tools.name: list_drawing_recipes
tools.title: List Drawing Recipes
tools.description: Lists compact audited layer, lineweight, projection, and export recipes.

tools.name: list_drawing_sheets
tools.title: List Drawing Sheets
tools.description:
List named sheets for Plan wrapup or Scene/Component/model review; combine filters with AND.

Returns cached registration data, total and truncation. Review names and locations
before deciding whether drawings are unnecessary; listing never deletes geometry.

tools.name: list_generation_phases
tools.title: List Generation Phases
tools.description: List organizational Phases with totals and an explicit truncation flag; limit is 1-500.

tools.name: list_generation_plan_revisions
tools.title: List Generation Plan Revisions
tools.description: List saved Plan revisions newest first, with operation labels and truncation metadata.

tools.name: list_generation_plans
tools.title: List Generation Plans
tools.description: List compact Plan summaries, optionally filtered by Phase, contextual Scene or status.

tools.name: list_library
tools.title: List Library
tools.description:
Lists all available physics logic archetypes in the Grasshopper library.
Use this tool first to discover what logic IDs are available before
calling get_logic_by_id.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.title: List Materials
tools.description:
Lists the curated PBR material library used by assign_material without changing Rhino.

Each entry carries metallic/roughness PBR channels, an Unreal material
slot name (ue_material_slot) for deterministic remapping after import,
and tags. layer_path is the canonical material-derived M:: hierarchy;
it is created lazily only when that material is applied to geometry.

tools.name: place_diagram_asset
tools.title: Place Diagram Asset
tools.description: Places an indexed diagram asset (SVG, DWG, DXF).

tools.name: place_drawing_asset
tools.title: Place Drawing Asset
tools.description:
Places an indexed representation asset as a reusable Rhino block.

x/y/z and returned bounds use the active document's units; scale is dimensionless.
Prepared 3DM geometry is converted from its stored millimeters by Rhino on import.
Drawing assets are placed on ALMOND-DRAW::ASSETS and remain distinct from
generated model blocks. The tool accepts only files resolved from the
controlled asset/drawing/DrawingAssetfiles manifest.

tools.name: publish_objects_to_chestnut
tools.title: Publish Objects To Chestnut
tools.description:
Exports specific Rhino objects as one GLB and publishes them to Chestnut.

Use this after execute_rhino_script (and optionally validate_structure), passing
the returned object GUIDs. Reusing asset_id updates the existing Chestnut asset
without changing placements that already reference it.

guids.description: Rhino object GUIDs to export. Unrelated document objects are excluded.

asset_id.description:
Stable optional ID for linked updates. Generated deterministically
      from the Rhino document and GUIDs when omitted.

body_type.description:
"static" for architecture, "dynamic" for loose props, or
       "kinematic" for script-driven objects.

collider.description:
Collider intent: "box", "convex", "compound", or "trimesh".
      Chestnut currently falls back to a box where needed.

preserve_scale.description:
Keep Rhino's real-world dimensions instead of normalizing
            the model to a one-metre display prop.

mass.description: Physics mass in kilograms. Static bodies always use zero.

tools.name: publish_to_chestnut
tools.title: Publish To Chestnut
tools.description:
Publishes Rhino objects to Chestnut using safe semantic defaults.

This is the preferred publishing tool for normal use. It hides collider,
scale, mass, and rigid-body details. Call it when the user says things such
as "publish that to Chestnut".

guids.description: Rhino object GUIDs returned by execute_rhino_script.

behavior.description:
Optional semantic preset:
"auto"         — infer architecture versus movable object from name
"architecture" — fixed building, terrain, structure, or enclosure
"object"       — movable physical prop affected by gravity
"animated"     — script-driven door, lift, platform, or mechanism

asset_id.description: Optional stable link ID. Omit for a deterministic Rhino link.

tools.name: register_drawing_asset
tools.title: Register Drawing Asset
tools.description:
Register a reviewed 3DM and automatically derive linked plan/front/right drawings.

Finish cleanup/orientation review with the asset-converter workflow first.
Supply an absolute prepared 3DM path: millimeters, Z up, bottom-center at origin.
Native geometry checks support meshes, Breps, extrusions, surfaces, SubD and nested
blocks, up to 100 MB/250k triangles. Unsupported objects reject the whole asset.
Copies the source, measures dimensions and writes DXF at full-size mm, SVG at
1:50/1:100 and A3 sheets where they fit. These are mesh silhouettes, not hidden
lines or construction details; visual classification/front are not verified.
Existing IDs require replace_existing=true. Prior files and manifest backups
are retained. Refreshes this MCP process's index after atomic publication;
other running processes must reconnect. The bundled Rhino panel is a release
snapshot; use MCP placement for newly registered local assets.

tools.name: register_scene_instance
tools.title: Register Scene Instance
tools.description:
Registers or moves an asset instance in millimetres without retransmitting
its full metadata. Returns a stable instance handle and scene revision.
When z_mm is omitted the instance stands on its room's floor (the room's
min_z), so rooms at storey elevation validate correctly.

tools.name: register_scene_objects
tools.title: Register Scene Objects
tools.description:
Link top-level objects directly to a Scene without an asset instance or Component.

mode is add, remove or replace for this document's direct links. Other model
links and Component membership are retained. Observe current GUIDs/bounds live;
this updates the local ledger and does not edit Rhino geometry or object names.

tools.name: remove_design_component
tools.title: Remove Design Component
tools.description:
Unregister Component ownership while preserving Rhino geometry and the ordinary group.

A root Component may have children; they become roots and keep their object
ownership, registered Rhino groups and Scene links. A Component that still has
its own parent must first be detached. Plan/Step/Sheet references to the
removed Component must be cleared first. No geometry is deleted or copied.

tools.name: remove_design_room
tools.title: Remove Design Room
tools.description:
Removes a room from the scene ledger. Instances that referenced it stay
in the scene, orphaned (re-home them with register_scene_instance).

tools.name: remove_drawing_sheet
tools.title: Remove Drawing Sheet
tools.description: Unregister a sheet while preserving its Rhino Layout, detail and modelspace drawing geometry.

tools.name: remove_scene_instance
tools.title: Remove Scene Instance
tools.description:
Removes an instance from the scene ledger (recorded as a revision delta).
The Rhino geometry, if any, is not touched.

tools.name: resolve_generation_targets
tools.title: Resolve Generation Targets
tools.description:
Resolve registered Step targets, or Plan targets when the Step has no override.

An explicit empty Step selection stays empty. Contextual Scenes never expand
targets. Returned group/document identities have live_verified=false; inspect
current Rhino state and user intent before editing. This does not grant authority.

tools.name: run_gh_definition
tools.title: Run Gh Definition
tools.description:
Runs an audited Grasshopper capsule (GH definition + typed contract) through
the Rhino bridge and returns its declared outputs.

Workflow: call list_capsules() first to pick a capsule_id and see its input/
output port names. Create any geometry with execute_rhino_script, then pass
the returned GUIDs here. Inputs are validated client-side against the capsule
manifest before anything is sent to Rhino, so errors from this tool name the
exact port at fault.

Input value forms (keyed by the exact ALMOND_IN_* port name):
  - Geometry ports (point/curve/mesh/brep and their [] list forms):
    {"guids": ["<rhino-object-guid>", ...]} referencing objects already in
    the Rhino document.
  - number / integer / string / bool ports: the raw JSON value.
  - number[] / integer[] / string[] ports: a flat JSON list.
Units are declared per port in the manifest — supply values in those units;
nothing is guessed or auto-converted client-side. Optional inputs may be
omitted; the capsule's declared defaults then apply inside the definition.

Only audited capsules run. audited=false means the GHX has no verified
ALMOND_IN_*/ALMOND_OUT_* harness params yet; this tool refuses it
(see asset/capsules/AUTHORING.md for how to harness one).

The response's "outputs" object is keyed by ALMOND_OUT_* names; interpret
each value using the manifest's semantics field (e.g. max_nodal_displacement,
per_element_utilization) and declared units. The response also carries
analysis_method (api|template|rule_based), confidence (high|medium|low),
warnings, and baked_guids — report method and confidence honestly;
rule_based/low means an estimate, not FEA.

inputs.description: Object mapping ALMOND_IN_* port names to values (forms above).

seed.description: Optional integer seed for stochastic definitions; omit for deterministic ones.

tools.name: search_asset_repository
tools.title: Search Asset Repository
tools.description:
Search the unified model/drawing archive. kind: all, model or element.

Returns stable IDs, file availability, dimensions and MCP resource URIs.
Drawing-ready means a derived projection package is linked to the object.

tools.name: search_detail_sources
tools.title: Search Detail Sources
tools.description:
Search six curated free architectural source directories offline.
Returns links, formats and rights notes; no external content is fetched.
Results are research candidates, not attributed inputs or certified details.
DETAIL subscription access is not required.

tools.name: search_diagram_assets
tools.title: Search Diagram Assets
tools.description: Searches the diagram asset library.

tools.name: search_drawing_assets
tools.title: Search Drawing Assets
tools.description: Searches only the controlled architectural drawing-asset library.

tools.name: sync_design_component
tools.title: Sync Design Component
tools.description:
Reconcile a Component after inspecting live Rhino group membership.

When group editing adds unowned TextDots/objects, one explicit native sync may
adopt their direct ownership under Undo and normalize ancestor memberships.
Unchanged components stay read-only. Conflicting ownership requires explicit
repair. A timed-out mutation is never automatically replayed.
A complete live proof of a previously registered but now unregistered group
also releases its cached registration, after checking Plan/Step/Sheet references.

tools.name: sync_drawing_sheet
tools.title: Sync Drawing Sheet
tools.description:
Reconcile a sheet from read-only native Layout inspection without replaying a mutation.

Use after a lost response, failed database commit or manual edits. Registered
snapshots can restore a missing ledger row. Verified unregistered retained
Layouts can release an existing ledger row; a missing Layout is not that proof.

tools.name: update_generation_phase
tools.title: Update Generation Phase
tools.description: Update Phase organization; omitted fields retain their values.

tools.name: update_generation_plan
tools.title: Update Generation Plan
tools.description:
Update Plan metadata and bindings atomically, recording a new saved revision.

Omitted fields retain prior values; [] clears refs, and phase_id='' detaches
the Phase. expected_revision rejects stale updates without changing the Plan.
References provide context and explicit targets, not permission to edit geometry.

tools.name: update_generation_step
tools.title: Update Generation Step
tools.description:
Record a Step's status, evidence and optional explicit Component targets.
Omitted refs retain prior values; [] clears them. Step component_ids=null in a
returned Plan inherits Plan targets; explicit [] selects none. Scene refs never
expand the selection. running/completed require completed prerequisites, and a
prerequisite cannot regress while descendants run or remain completed.
expected_revision rejects stale updates. No Rhino operation is executed here.

tools.name: upsert_design_component
tools.title: Upsert Design Component
tools.description:
Register direct objects and optional nested child Components in an explicit Rhino group.

object_ids names DIRECT top-level owners (possibly [] when child_component_ids
contains existing children). child_component_ids=None preserves existing children;
[] explicitly detaches them. Each object has exactly one direct Component owner,
and each child at most one parent in the same document without cycles. Parent
group selection includes descendants without rewriting their direct owner IDs.
Every Component needs at least one existing Scene; omitting scene_ids preserves
an existing association. Geometry is not copied or duplicated.
expected_model_path must match the active saved document. After an uncertain
native result, inspect and sync_design_component; do not replay the mutation.

tools.name: upsert_design_room
tools.title: Upsert Design Room
tools.description:
Creates or updates a legacy room envelope for asset-placement containment checks.
Use upsert_design_component for physical architectural assemblies.
bounds_mm is [min_x, min_y, min_z, max_x, max_y, max_z]. When room_id is
omitted, an existing room with the same name in the scene is updated
instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: upsert_drawing_sheet
tools.title: Upsert Drawing Sheet
tools.description:
Register one authored modelspace drawing region with one Rhino Layout tab.

Supply world-XY bounds [minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ] in mm, positive XY
extents, paper [width,height] in mm, and a positive scale denominator (100 = 1:100).
The native Layout uses a parallel Top detail; the region must fit at that scale.
drawing_type is plan, section, elevation, detail, axonometric, perspective,
schedule or other. These are labels; this tool does not generate drawing geometry.
New sheets create a Layout when layout_id is empty. Existing identities cannot
change model or Layout. Omitted refs preserve existing values; [] clears refs,
plan_id='' unlinks a Plan. List sheets by Plan at wrapup to inspect duplicates.
After an uncertain result, sync_drawing_sheet; do not replay the mutation.

tools.name: validate_scene_layout
tools.title: Validate Scene Layout
tools.description:
Runs cached legacy asset-instance AABB collisions and room-containment checks.
Component/raw-object geometry is reported as unvalidated; inspect it with native probes.

tools.name: validate_structure
tools.title: Validate Structure
tools.description:
Validates AI-generated geometry with a structural analysis.
Call this AFTER execute_rhino_script to verify the generated structure is buildable.

engine="auto" (default) analyses line models (beams, columns, trusses, frames) with
Almond's built-in 3D frame solver: analysis_method "native", confidence "high",
no Karamba install needed. It is a linear-elastic first-order frame analysis with
EN 1993-1-1 member checks (elastic moduli; flexural buckling with L_cr = member
length; no lateral-torsional buckling), benchmarked against closed-form results
and live Karamba runs. Models with shells, and shell/gridshell/membrane structure
types, go to Karamba. engine="karamba" forces the Karamba route, which tries three
pathways in strict order of confidence and always tells you which one ran:
    analysis_method "api"        — direct Karamba 3.1 API solve, confidence "high"
    analysis_method "template"   — audited capsule GHX template,  confidence "medium"
    analysis_method "rule_based" — heuristic span/slenderness rules, confidence "low"
The verdict string names the method (e.g. "[RULE-BASED ESTIMATE, LOW CONFIDENCE] ...").
Treat rule_based/low results as estimates, NOT finite element analysis, and say so
when reporting to the user.

If the structure FAILS, modify the design (add supports, increase member size,
change material) and call execute_rhino_script + validate_structure again.
When worst_member_guids is present, edit only those offending members instead
of regenerating everything. Iterate up to 3 times before reporting the best attempt.

guids.description: List of Rhino object GUID strings from execute_rhino_script output.

structure_type.description:
Analysis template to use. Options:
"beam"       — simple beam bending/deflection
"truss"      — axial force/buckling analysis
"shell"      — shell stress/displacement
"frame"      — moment/shear frame analysis
"canopy"     — cantilevered canopy
"gridshell"  — large deformation gridshell
"membrane"   — form-finding membrane
"highrise"   — high-rise structural systems

fixed_supports.description: True = fully fixed supports, False = pinned (rotations free).

span_m.description:
structural span in meters for the L/250 limit when members are split at
every node (e.g. a 6.2 m joist drawn as two 3.1 m segments). Native engine only.

asset_loads.description:
add the gravity loads of placed library assets (estimated self weight
plus in-use contents/occupants from each asset's load entry, e.g. a filled
bathtub) where they stand on (or hang from) the frame. Placements come from
Rhino objects tagged with an Almond asset id, or from the scene ledger when
scene_id is given. Native engine only; the result's "asset_loads" lists every
placement with its load and carrying members, or why it was not applied.

scene_id.description: scene ledger to read placements from (default: tagged Rhino objects).

floor_load_kn_m2.description:
imposed floor load in kN/m2 (e.g. 2.0 for homes, EN 1991-1-1
category A) on every bay enclosed by beams on a level; the beams take it by the
45-degree rule (two-way, one-way above 2:1). Native engine only. A code floor load
already covers movable furniture and people: combine it with asset_loads only for
heavy specific items, and set load_kn to 0 to avoid double counting.

floor_dead_kn_m2.description:
superimposed dead load in kN/m2 (floor build-up, finishes) on the
same bays.

design_basis.description:
"en1990" (default): deflection at SLS characteristic (G + Q), member
checks at ULS 1.35 G + 1.5 Q. G = self weight, floor build-up and the weight of
placed items; Q = load_kn, the occupancy floor load, contents and occupants.
"unfactored" checks both at G + Q (the Karamba route's basis). Native engine.

uls_combination.description:
"6.10" or "6.10ab" (the worse of 6.10a and 6.10b per member). Default:
the design code's choice (Eurocode profile: 6.10). A profile that prescribes one
expression overrides the request (with a warning).

connections.description:
"rigid" (default: every joint transmits moment) or "simple": beams are
pinned (major-axis bending released) and braces pinned in both axes where they
stop - not where another member carries on in line - while columns stay
continuous. Typical bolted steel and timber framing is closer to "simple"; rigid
joints can flatter beam deflection. A curve's user text almond:release = "pinned" |
"pinned_start" | "pinned_end" | "rigid" overrides either mode. Native engine.

stability.description:
"auto" (default): elastic critical load factor alpha_cr for every ULS
combination (EN 1993-1-1 5.2.1) and sway imperfections phi = 1/200 x alpha_h x alpha_m
(5.3.2) in +/-x and +/-y; alpha_cr < 10 runs a second-order (P-Delta) ULS analysis,
alpha_cr <= 1 fails as unstable. "off": first-order without imperfections.

design_code.description:
design code profile for the numbers a code or National Annex sets
(gamma_G, gamma_Q, psi_0, xi, gamma_M0, gamma_M1, deflection limit): "eurocode"
(default, EN recommended values), any profile from list_design_codes, or "off"
(unfactored G + Q, no partial factors; same as design_basis="unfactored").
Results carry "design_code" with the values used and any unverified ones.

detail.description:
native engine only. Adds "members" (per member: role, length, section, ULS design
forces N/V/M/T, governing combination and check, slenderness, chi, stress,
utilization, SLS deflection and span/deflection ratio, pinned ends) and "supports"
(reactions Fx..Mz at SLS and each ULS combination). Off by default to keep replies short.

fabrication.description:
hollow steel sections (CHS/RHS) are "cold_formed" (default, EN 10219,
buckling curve c) or "hot_finished" (EN 10210, curve a; a0 for S460). The difference
is up to about 23 % in buckling resistance; use hot_finished only when specified.

tools.name: visualize_structure
tools.title: Visualize Structure
tools.description:
Run a live structural analysis on a line model and SHOW it in every Rhino viewport:
the undeformed wireframe, the exaggerated deformed shape coloured blue -> red by
displacement (or by utilization), supports, load arrows and a legend panel with
max deflection, the L/limit check and PASS/FAIL. Nothing is baked into the document.

Use it to make structural behaviour visible while designing: model the structural
axes as curves, include Rhino point objects at the supports, call this tool, then
fix the members it shows in red (add a column, shorten a cantilever, upsize the
section via beam_diameter_mm) and call it again. validate_structure gives the
auditable verdict; this tool is the visual, iterative view of the same solve.

guids.description:
Curve GUIDs of the structural axes plus point GUIDs marking supports
(see fixed_supports). Without points, the lowest nodes are supported.

load_kn.description: Total imposed load in kN, shared equally by the free nodes (-Z).

fixed_supports.description: True = fully fixed supports, False = pinned (rotations free).

deflection_limit_ratio.description:
span/ratio limit, e.g. 250 for L/250. Default: the design code's
limit (Eurocode profile: 250).

span_m.description:
reference span in meters for the limit (default: longest member).
Set it when members are split at every node, e.g. a 6.2 m joist drawn
as two 3.1 m segments.

scale.description: deformation exaggeration; omit for automatic (~6% of span).

reveal.description: 0..1 fraction of members drawn (for staged construction playback).

reanalyze.description:
False re-uses the last solve and only changes the display
(scale / color_by / reveal / physics / title) - cheap enough to animate.

physics.description:
False draws the same members as plain geometry with no analysis
overlay ("physics off"), for before/after comparisons.

display_guids.description:
draw only these members (e.g. one frame line for a section
view); the analysis still covers every member in guids.

engine.description:
"auto" (default: Almond's native frame solver, no Karamba needed; Karamba
when the selection has shells or the bridge cannot export a model),
"native" or "karamba".

connections.description:
"rigid" or "simple", as in validate_structure; pinned ends are drawn
as small circles.

view.description:
"deflection" (default) or "buckling": draw the first buckling mode of the
governing ULS combination with its alpha_cr (STABLE >= 10, SWAY-SENSITIVE 1-10,
UNSTABLE <= 1) instead of the deflected shape.
